correctness.rationale: The heteroclinic time derivative Θ_q'(y)=1/[y^q(1−y)] and linearized homogeneous speed G_q yield w(t)=G_q(y(t))∫_{t*}^t ε(s)ds. The left-envelope root gap D has D'(y)=y^(1−q)/[(1−y)(q−1−qy)^2]>0, with −∞/+∞ endpoint signs; hence a unique pre-pin maximizer. The right side is bounded by log[q/(q−1)]<1/(q−1)<B_q, proving global unique sharp operator norm with constant forcing. The high-order change z=q(1−y) gives a decreasing limit E(z)=exp(z)/(z−1)−∫_1^z exp(u)/u du with unique zero; bracketing traps z_q and yields the claimed universal limits. Independently differentiated the critical identities symbolically and recomputed 7 roots plus limiting z*=4.300640970392886. At finite intervals the universal B_q is attained only if y_q is included. The unweighted norm and nonlinear/discrete inverse are not claimed.
